title: Odell Beckham Jr. reclaims No. 13 with Giants after wearing No. 3 during preseason

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Odell Beckham Jr. reclaims No. 13 with Giants after wearing No. 3 during preseason
sources.description: Beckham will re-emerge in Week 1 with the Giants in a spot that recalls the moment he made No. 13 his own — at home against the Cowboys on "Sunday Night Football."
